question: For veg whsle data, can you analyze our financial performance over the years 2020 to 2023? I need insights into the average wholesale price, maximum wholesale price, minimum wholesale price, wholesale price difference, total wholesale price, total selling price, average loss rate, total loss, and profit for each category within each year. Round all calculated values to two decimal places.
sql:
-- Verify row count
WITH wholesale_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        SUBSTR(v.whsle_date, 1, 4) as year,
        c.category_name,
        ROUND(AVG(v."whsle_px_rmb-kg"), 2) as avg_wholesale_price,
        ROUND(MAX(v."whsle_px_rmb-kg"), 2) as max_wholesale_price,
        ROUND(MIN(v."whsle_px_rmb-kg"), 2) as min_wholesale_price,
        ROUND(MAX(v."whsle_px_rmb-kg") - MIN(v."whsle_px_rmb-kg"), 2) as wholesale_price_diff,
        ROUND(SUM(v."whsle_px_rmb-kg"), 2) as total_wholesale_price
    FROM veg_whsle_df v
    JOIN veg_cat c ON v.item_code = c.item_code
    WHERE SUBSTR(v.whsle_date, 1, 4) BETWEEN '2020' AND '2023'
    GROUP BY SUBSTR(v.whsle_date, 1, 4), c.category_name
),
selling_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        SUBSTR(v.txn_date, 1, 4) as year,
        c.category_name,
        ROUND(SUM(v."qty_sold(kg)" * v."unit_selling_px_rmb/kg"), 2) as total_selling_price
    FROM veg_txn_df v
    JOIN veg_cat c ON v.item_code = c.item_code
    WHERE SUBSTR(v.txn_date, 1, 4) BETWEEN '2020' AND '2023'
        AND v."sale/return" = 'sale'
    GROUP BY SUBSTR(v.txn_date, 1, 4), c.category_name
),
wholesale_cost AS (
    SELECT 
        SUBSTR(vt.txn_date, 1, 4) as year,
        c.category_name,
        ROUND(SUM(vw."whsle_px_rmb-kg" * vt."qty_sold(kg)"), 2) as total_wholesale_cost
    FROM veg_whsle_df vw
    JOIN veg_txn_df vt ON vw.item_code = vt.item_code 
        AND SUBSTR(vw.whsle_date, 1, 10) = SUBSTR(vt.txn_date, 1, 10)
    JOIN veg_cat c ON vw.item_code = c.item_code
    WHERE SUBSTR(vw.whsle_date, 1, 4) BETWEEN '2020' AND '2023'
        AND vt."sale/return" = 'sale'
    GROUP BY SUBSTR(vt.txn_date, 1, 4), c.category_name
),
loss_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        c.category_name,
        ROUND(AVG(vl."loss_rate_%"), 2) as avg_loss_rate
    FROM veg_loss_rate_df vl
    JOIN veg_cat c ON vl.item_code = c.item_code
    GROUP BY c.category_name
)
SELECT 
    wm.year,
    wm.category_name,
    wm.avg_wholesale_price,
    wm.max_wholesale_price,
    wm.min_wholesale_price,
    wm.wholesale_price_diff,
    wm.total_wholesale_price,
    sm.total_selling_price,
    lm.avg_loss_rate,
    ROUND(wc.total_wholesale_cost * lm.avg_loss_rate / 100, 2) as total_loss,
    ROUND(sm.total_selling_price - wc.total_wholesale_cost, 2) as profit
FROM wholesale_metrics wm
JOIN selling_metrics sm ON wm.year = sm.year AND wm.category_name = sm.category_name
JOIN wholesale_cost wc ON wm.year = wc.year AND wm.category_name = wc.category_name
JOIN loss_metrics lm ON wm.category_name = lm.category_name
ORDER BY wm.year, wm.category_name
